title: Concession Strategy
description: How you give ground matters more than how much.

sections.title: Quick Understanding
sections.content: Concessions send signals. Making them too fast, too large or too random tells the other side you will keep giving. Planned, shrinking concessions signal that you are near your limit.

sections.title: Why It Works
sections.content: The pattern of concessions is read as a map of your resolve. Decreasing increments suggest the end is near; large early moves invite pressure for more.

sections.title: Real-Life Examples
content: Opening at 10, then 7, then 5, then 4 signals you are nearly done.
Dropping straight to your limit invites a demand for more.

sections.title: What It Looks Like
content: Concessions given only in exchange for something.

sections.title: How to Use It
sections.content: Plan your sequence in advance, make each concession smaller than the last, and always trade it for a concession in return.

sections.title: Red Flags
content: The other side conceding nothing while you concede repeatedly.
Concessions demanded without anything offered back.

sections.title: Defense Strategies
content: Never concede without asking for something in return.
Read the pattern of their concessions, not just the number.

sections.title: Mistakes People Make
content: Making equal-sized concessions that signal endless room.

sections.title: Key Lessons
content: Shrink your steps as you approach your limit.
